# 2.5 Removing Spatial Correlation in Mods. w/ Raw Traits
 This script require ~3 GiB of RAM Memory
 Always run  in a clean r-session with an empty environment

# Packages, settings and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())         # Clear all objects from the environment
gc()                    # Run garbage collection to free memory

# Function to compute MEM (Moran's Eigenvector Maps) and test for spatial autocorrelation
test_mem <- function(res, lw, nmodel = NULL) {
  mem <- mem.select(res, lw, method = "MIR", nperm = 999, p.adjust = T)  # Run MEM selection with permutation

  # Extract global Moran’s I and p-value
  sac <- data.frame(
    I = mem$global.test$obs,
    Pvalue = mem$global.test$pvalue
  ) %>%
    mutate(model = nmodel, .before = I) %>%
    `rownames<-`(NULL)

  # If MEM vectors were selected
  if (length(mem) > 1) {
    message('Check MEM data for eigenvectors...')
    mem_data <- list(
      sac = sac,                      # Moran's I summary
      selected.MEM = mem$MEM.select,  # Selected eigenvectors
      summary = mem$summary           # Full summary with p-values
    )
    return(mem_data)
  } else {
    message('No MEM selected...')
    return(sac)
  }
}

# Function to summarize model results: mean ± sd for each column (excluding model name)
get_df <- function (x) {
  model = x[1, 1]
  mean = t(apply(x[, -1], MARGIN = 2, function(y)
           {paste0(round(mean(y),3), '[±', round(sd (y),3), ']')}
           ))
  data.frame (model, mean)
}

# Packages
# devtools::install_github("cran/SoDA", force = T) #install SoDA to deal with coords
require(spdep)
library(ade4)
library(adespatial)
library(SoDA)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(sp)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

## Define reproducibility
set.seed(811)
## Set the return of numeric values only (not scientific notations)
options(scipen = 99997) 
# number of elements (ie. trees or repetitions)
N = 1000
```

## Load data

```{r}

all_df <- readRDS(file = 'data/cwm_values_raw.RDS') %>%
  column_to_rownames('Site')  # Load community-weighted mean values

models <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  "outputs/Corrected/mod_select_cwm.xlsx",
  sheet = "nice_mode_S"
)  # Load selected models per trait

cwm_list <- readRDS("data/cwm_list.RDS")  # Load list of CWM matrices per trait and iteration
```

## Start parallel computing
```{r}
no_cores <- detectCores() - 4  # Use all cores minus 4 (adjust to 5 for desktop)
registerDoParallel(cores = no_cores)
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores, type = "FORK")  # Create parallel backend
```

## Spatial correlation
### Creating coord. distance matrix
```{r}
## Creating a cartesian coordinates df, which will permit Euclidean distance usage
df_xy <- SoDA::geoXY(
  latitude = all_df$Lat,
  longitude = all_df$Long,
  unit = 1000
)
dist <- dist(df_xy) # Compute Euclidean distances
```

### Spatial Weighted Matrix

```{r}
nb <- chooseCN(coordinates(df_xy), type = 4, plot.nb = FALSE)  # Create neighborhood graph (MST)
distnb <- nbdists(nb, df_xy)  # Get pairwise distances for each link
fdist <- lapply(distnb, function(x) 1 - x / max(dist(df_xy)))  # Convert distances to similarity weights

# Create listw object (spatial weights)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = 'B', glist = fdist, zero.policy = TRUE)
```

### Creating a connectivity matrix based in Bauman (2018) proceed

```{r}
models$models
# Rhyzome diameter
models[grep("diam", models$models), ]$models
model <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  # Create model iteratively for the 1000 phylo scenarios
  lm(
    cwm_list$diam[[i]] ~ nitrogen + plot_size + samp_size,
    data = all_df
  )

# Extract residual
res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

# Mesure Moran I and p-values
mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'diam~N')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

# Get summary model results
sac_diam <- get_df(mem)

# Compact Rhizome
models$models
model <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$r_comp[[i]] ~ cec + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'Rhiz. Comp~CEC')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_rcomp <- get_df(mem)

# Short Creeping Rhizome
models$models
model <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$r_cr[[i]] ~ ann_prec + prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'Rhiz. Short~AP+PS')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_rcr <- get_df(mem)

# Multipinnate laminae
models$models
model <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$l_mseg[[i]] ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'lmseg~AP')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_lmseg <- get_df(mem)

# Buds
models[grep("buds", models$models), ]$models

model <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$buds[[i]] ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'buds~AP')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_buds <- get_df(mem)

# Frond Dimorphism

models[grep("lmorf", models$models), ]$models
model <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$lmorf[[i]] ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'lmorf~AP')
  }

mem_result <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    mem[[i]]$sac
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_lmorf <- get_df(mem_result)

mem_morf <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% mem[[i]]$selected.MEM

lapply(mem_morf, ncol) > 1

Iresid <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    df <- mem[[i]]$summary
    df[which.max(df$pvalue), ]
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

df_resid <- data.frame(
  model = Iresid[1, 1],
  mean = t(apply(Iresid[, -1], MARGIN = 2, mean)),
  sd = t(apply(Iresid[, -1], MARGIN = 2, sd))
)
sd()

# Save
openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(Iresid, df_resid), "outputs/Corrected/summ_residual_I_tcor.xlsx")

# Spore Chlorophyll

models[grep("Chl", models$models), ]$models
model <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(cwm_list$chl[[i]] ~ prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size, data = all_df)

res <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% residuals(model[[i]])

mem <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    test_mem(res[[i]], lw, nmodel = 'Chlorophyll~AP')
  } %>%
  list_rbind()

sac_chl <- get_df(mem)
```

## Stop parallel computing ####
```{r}
stopCluster(cl)
```
## Saving data

```{r}
# Combine all in a matrix
cor_df <-
  rbind(sac_diam, sac_rcr, sac_rcomp, sac_lmseg, sac_buds, sac_lmorf, sac_chl)


cor_df$data <- paste0(cor_df$I,"(", cor_df$Pvalue,")") 

cor_df

#Save data
wb_s_correl <-openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  file = "outputs/Corrected/models_sac_scomp.xlsx",
  x = list(df = cor_df, resid_lmorf = Iresid)
)

saveRDS(mem_morf, file = "outputs/RDS/mem_scomp.RDS")
```
